item.statement: Degenerate and boundary valid inputs must resolve by mathematical floor-modulo; in particular width=1 or height=1 collapses the corresponding axis and negative shifts wrap without C-remainder behavior.

plans.objective: Probe degenerate axes and negative wrap boundaries.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every case matches the floor-mod oracle bitwise, including negative shifts resolving into [0,width-1] and [0,height-1].
plans.setup: Run (width,height) in {(1,1),(1,32),(32,1)} with pitch>=width and shifts {-1,0,1,width,height,-width,-height}; compute floor-mod oracle.
